title: The Latest Crier for Nov 02, 2026
items:
Peer PE

Peer PE is back! Join SAAC as we host middle- and high-school students for a morning of movement and fun! Wear RED and plan to be active! Your role as volunteer is flexible; please come-and-go as your schedule allows. Logistics: November 3, 9:30-11 am, Location: Kuyper fieldhouse

Writer's Reading Series with Dr. Kate Nesbit

Join Geisler Library for the next installment in the Writer's Reading series featuring Dr. Kate Nesbit, Associate Professor of English. Dr. Nesbit will read selections from her book, Willful Listeners: Reading Aloud and the Politics of Attention from Austen to Audiobooks . Wednesday, November 4th at 4:30 PM in the Graham Conference Center Fireside Room. Light refreshments and snacks will be provided. Enjoy an inspiring evening celebrating literature and creative writing on campus!

Voting in Pella

How to vote on November 3: 
Registered to vote in Pella? The voting location for Central College is United Methodist Church, 1414 University St 

Going home to vote? Use this link to find your place to vote! 

Not registered to vote? Not registered to vote in Pella? Never fear, you can still vote on election day! Click here to understand how to do same day voting. Students can download their housing lease to show proof of their Pella address: 

Student.central.edu, Log in, Under Resident Life, Click Housing Agreement, Download and print 

All Iowa voting locations have the same hours: 7am - 8pm ! Be in line by 8pm and you will get to vote. 

If you have any questions, stop in at the Student Development Office!

Meals from the Heartland with SSS

SSS is sponsoring , Meals from the Heartland , which is a non-profit organization from Des Moines that packs & sends meals to folks all over the world! Our service project will take place in the Central College field house on the West end of the indoor track on Thursday, November 12, 2026 . Sign up to pack meals or you can also be a table leader that helps fill the buckets. This is a fun event!!! 😊 
Shift 1 : 9:30-10:45 am - 60 people packing meals plus 5 table leaders 

Shift 2 : 11:00 am -12:15 pm - 60 people packing meals plus 5 table leaders 

Thank you!!

Fun Service Opportunities! Green Pod Hours!

Mark your calendar for some volunteer opportunties that count for green pod hours! It will be a great time in community & making a difference in the world. Join us as we serve 11/9 from 5 to 6:30 pm at the Pella Food Shelf. Use the link below to reserve your spot: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1q2jhNfSLPQ4DDH2Xr2C28F7Nq11HH8UNohPgIi7S1_4/edit?usp=sharing

Interested in building your resume, growing as a leader, and making a difference at Central?

You can do all that and more by becoming an RA! Click here for more information on the job and to appy. Benefits include a partial room waiver, a double-as-a-single room at no extra charge, and a flexible work schedule. See your RA or area coordinator if you have questions!

CROSS CON27! St. Louis over New Years Eve!!

Let's head to THE DOME in St. Louis over New Years Eve! Join us 12/31-1/3 for a conference with thousands of your peers learning from scripture, hearing from famous Bible teachers like David Platt Kevin DeYoung, & John Piper, worshiping with artists Matt Boswell & The Worship Initiative, & a day of sightseeing in St. Louis. Early-bird discount is $180 by 11/4 & final deadline of $200 by 11/16. 
sign up here: https://forms.gle/Sp4rucYfiy6y1tyy8 

more info here: https://www.crosscon.com/

Fall Intramural Sign-Ups

Fall Intramural sign-ups are open! Make sure to get your teams together and sign up for those! Follow along on our Instagram (@CentralCollegeIM) for updates on when sign-ups open/close! Use our Linktree to take you to our hub for sign-ups: https://linktr.ee/centralcollegeim
